explanation: No fault is visible in the supplied two-job execution. Job 1 selected and preserved all eight qualifying demand records and produced evidence_sources in demand-descending provenance order. Job 2 consumed both handoffs, mapped capabilities by unchanged need text and record identity, ranked unsupported records first while preserving upstream rank order, and recommended the first priority.
cited_evidence: Job 1 output needs contains all stipulated record_ids n06-r01 through n06-r08 with the original need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight values.
Job 1 output evidence_sources ranks n06-r01 through n06-r08 as 1 through 8, matching descending demand_score order with the tied demand_score 6 records ordered n06-r04 before n06-r05.
Job 2 coverage marks n06-r01 and n06-r07 as coverage "none" and maps the other six records to the supplied matching capability_ids without changing need text or record_id.
Job 2 priorities place unsupported n06-r01 then n06-r07 first, followed by supported records in upstream_rank order 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, and recommendation.top_need is the priority-rank-1 need.
